latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate videos instantly from text or images, no login required.

- Upload text, images, or videos (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG up to 200MB) and turn them into ready-to-share videos in about 30-60 seconds.
- Automatically handles anonymous sign-in and session setup; no account creation needed.
- Supports exporting 1080p MP4 videos, as well as other popular formats.
- Easily check credits, job status, and manage uploads with simple chat commands.
- All rendering is done server-side using cloud GPUs — nothing to install locally.
